details.cardSet: Combined Set "Worldreaver's Descent & Dominion of Darkness"
details.effect: Choose one. (1) Give your leader [defense]+2. Draw 2 cards. (2) Search your deck for up to 2 different cards with "Meowskers" in their names, summon them, then shuffle.

options.label: Search your deck for up to 2 different cards with "Meowskers" in their names, summon them, then shuffle.

issues: Second choose option is encoded as searchDeckSummonMultiple with remainderTo deckBottom and maxTotalCost 999, but the card says to search your deck for up to 2 different cards with 'Meowskers' in their names, summon them, then shuffle. It should be encoded as tutoring up to 2 distinct matching cards from the whole deck directly to the field and then shuffling, not as a top-of-deck look/summon-multiple effect.
